name: Kido Shouhei
source:
The protagonist of the game, or more like the victim, who is timid and introverted. He says logical things most of the time. Loves Nonohara Aoi, but doesn't take action. In general, he is a good boy who loves anime and games, with a bit of a nerdy side. 

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=781405]Getchu[/url]]
